headline: Linn Of Mercy Reignites Amid Rising Attrition In Dead Lands
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch three hours ago, heavy fighting has sharply reignited across the Linn of Mercy, where four rapid base transitions and a sudden surge in casualties and enlistments mark a newly volatile central sector. Dead Lands has likewise sustained active structural turnover, recording fresh base changes in the latest hour alongside unrelenting attritional fire. To the northeast, Weathered Expanse continues to absorb immense combat losses, with Warden casualty rates accelerating sharply over the past hour despite frontlines remaining static. Conversely, the intense island sparring previously recorded across Lykos Isle has cooled without new base exchanges over the last two hours, mirroring the steadying lines in Fisherman's Row and Stonecradle. Contested sectors across Stlican Shelf, Loch Mor, and Farranac Coast have similarly cooled in casualty tempo, leaving the central corridor of Linn of Mercy and Dead Lands as the foremost focal points of active maneuvering.
